tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud & Integration Consultant | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise e-commerce and integration platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes, and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] Hiring: SAP BTP Integration Consultant
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of hands-on experience engineering enterprise SAP Commerce and integration solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in connecting complex e-commerce ecosystems with ERP and MDM platforms. I am very enthusiastic about bringing my integration and backend capabilities to support your consulting initiatives.

bullets.label: SAP Integration & ERP Connectivity
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee platforms at Rockwell Automation, ensuring robust data flows and system stability across global channels.

bullets.label: API & Headless Services
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs at Shell and Rockwell Automation, integrating third-party consumers and external platforms securely through the SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2).

bullets.label: Data Pipelines & PIM Synchronization
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across enterprise channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Acted in a techno-functional capacity bridging business and technical teams, analysing integration requirements, writing functional specifications, and guiding stakeholders through complex platform migrations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my integration and SAP experience aligns with your goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to apply my 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce and integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell to deliver high-impact integration solutions for your clients. My strong background in connecting ERP, PIM, and external platforms via robust APIs and data pipelines enables me to hit the ground running and add immediate value.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce and integration expertise, connecting ERP and enterprise platforms through robust APIs and data pipelines.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce and enterprise integration experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell, specializing in APIs, ERP data pipelines, and techno-functional delivery. My CV and cover letter are attached. I am available from 16.12.2026 and would love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: [Post] Hiring: SAP BTP Integration Consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP integration consultant opportunity. With over 5 years of hands-on experience delivering complex SAP Commerce, API, and ERP integration solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring proven expertise in connecting enterprise platforms and managing data pipelines.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am available to start from 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
